title: Plough
prompt: a miniature plough in a tray of soil on a table with three buttons: “Lower” sets the share into the soil; “Pull” cuts and overturns a furrow; “Deepen” increases the draft force; see-through reveals the coulter, share, mouldboard and the two wedge actions
blurb: A teaching plough cuts and turns soil in a tray, with a deeper cut increasing an illustrative draft index.
representativeMechanism: Single-bottom walking mouldboard plough with knife coulter and wooden beam and handles.
teachingAdaptations: Tray and tabletop are teaching fixtures.
Lower stages external handling. Pull supplies external draft; no hidden motor is claimed.
Lower after a finished pass replaces the specimen and returns the tool.
Soil is drawn as coherent slices rather than granular fracture.
Draft index = cut depth / 8 cm at fixed width, speed and soil; it is an illustrative comparison, not a measured force.
Dimensions and timing are illustrative, not a scale model of a named product.

claims: Knife coulter cuts vertically ahead of share.
Share cuts horizontally; mouldboard lifts and turns; landside bears on furrow wall.
Share, mouldboard and landside mount on frog supported by standard attached to beam.
Mouldboard turns soil; landside stabilizes horizontal load.
sources.limitation: Modern disc-coulter tractor example supports the plough bottom and load path, not an exact replica.

claims: Museum catalog search result documents wooden beam, hitch hole, handles and metal mouldboard and share.
sources.limitation: Full page returned HTTP 500 during research; catalog search text was available.

telemetry.reason: Standalone static figure has no production telemetry; live verification untested.
